verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents one first-party AI feature, AI-powered creation of meeting minutes for record keeping, which generates content from user-supplied information inside the product. The custom summary of required licenses and permits is personalized output, but it is not described as AI-driven, and nothing shows AI analyzing the user's business data to surface insights or recommendations. Missing for 10: AI-generated insights or suggestions from account or business data, any detail on the AI meeting-minutes feature, independent or hands-on corroboration.
